_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Computer Aided Cell Development Data
summary: Computer Aided Cell Development Data documents the process for fabricating integrated circuit cells using computer aids, enabling the Government to independently evaluate contractor-fabricated device reliability.
use_relationship:
Computer Aided Cell Development Data documents the process for fabrication of integrated circuit cells using computer aids.
Computer Aided Cell Development Data is used by the Government to independently evaluate the reliability of electronic devices fabricated by the contractor.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID supercedes DI-MCCR-80500.
This DID is related to DI-MCCR-80499A, Computer Aided Chip Development Data.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of solicitation; or for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

children.title: The contractor shall prepare and deliver cell development data in accordance with the following:
The contractor shall utilize and submit the computer aided cell development data on digital media in the following order of preference:
The contractor shall utilize electronic media, in accordance with the instructions for digital submissions, for all other documentation and reports.
Computer Aided Cell Development Data shall be provided in the following formats:
Circuit schematic data (identified in Paragraph 3.10d) shall be provided in either SPICE or CDL netlist format.
children.content: Other formats will be considered with approval at the discretion of the Government Program Manager.

children.title: Logic equation and/or truth table data (identified in paragraph 3.10f) shall be provided as a simulation model preferably in Verilog or VHDL format.
children.content: Logic equations are acceptable provided any and all math symbols are defined. Truth tables are acceptable provided all inputs, outputs, and bi-directionals are identified. Truth table columns shall be tab delimited. The contractor shall verify that all input and bi-directional input combinations are accounted for, and that any symbols used in the truth table are defined.

children.title: Composite layout data (identified in paragraph 3.1.i) shall be provided in the GDSII file (described in DI-IPSC-80409A).
